'''The Corkscrew''' was the very last part of the final stretch of canyon of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends#The_Mos_Espa_circuit|Mos Espa Circuit]] before the open [[Hutt Flats/Legends|Hutt Flats]]. It resembled a corkscrew&mdash;hence its name. [[Devil's Doorknob/Legends|Devil's Doorknob]] ended the canyon.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
